title: Fix Next.js build: Add required HTML structure to root layout
body:
Next.js build failed with TypeScript error: root layout returned `ReactNode` instead of expected HTML document structure.

## Changes

- Wrapped children in `<html>` and `<body>` tags in `apps/docs/app/layout.tsx`

Next.js 16 requires root layouts to return complete HTML structure. The previous implementation returned children directly, which violated the framework's type constraints:

```tsx
// Before
export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return children;
}

// After  
export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

The language-specific layout in `app/[lang]/layout.tsx` already had proper HTML structure. Middleware continues handling locale routing unchanged.
